name: brave-search
title: Brave Search
description: Web and news search through the official Brave Search API: title, URL and description (news: age and source), with country and freshness filters. Needs an API key from https://brave.com/search/api/ in BRAVE_API_KEY and network: Allowlist with api.search.brave.com:443.
notes: The key is passed as an environment variable and never returned or logged by the server.
